U_is: Q for target i, condition s

bootstrap_test_details.Holm: Within each frozen RQ family, sort raw p ascending (ties by listed contrast order). p_adj(j)=min(1,max_{l<=j}((m-l+1)*p_(l))). NI passes iff theta_hat > -0.25 and p_adj <= 0.05.
bootstrap_test_details.NI_boundary_distribution: theta_null_b = -0.25 + e_b; count theta_null_b >= observed theta_hat.
bootstrap_test_details.NI_compatible_lower_bound: Invert the same centered-bootstrap upper-tail test at the applicable alpha; not the ordinary two-sided percentile effect interval.
bootstrap_test_details.NI_method: One-sided null-boundary-centered paired transcript-cluster bootstrap test.
bootstrap_test_details.cluster_population: All transcript clusters in the shared_16 primary population. Preserve complete eligible targets, fixed condition vectors and fixed group labels with cluster multiplicity.
bootstrap_test_details.construct_cluster_duplicates: Preserve each target condition vector and cluster multiplicity; use equivalent frequency weights or distinct replicated target IDs, not deduplication.
bootstrap_test_details.draw_algorithm: Sort transcript_id numerically. NumPy Generator(PCG64(42)); draw G integer indices in [0,G) with replacement per replicate, b=1..5000. Use shared draws across all estimands and conditions.
bootstrap_test_details.effect_interval: Ordinary two-sided [2.5%,97.5%] percentile interval of theta_star; linear interpolation (type 7). Report separately from NI decision.
bootstrap_test_details.mechanism_groups: Compute both group-specific paired means within each shared cluster draw, then subtract. Do not independently resample groups. Empty-group replicates are undefined, must be counted/reported, and must never be assigned zero or silently redrawn.
bootstrap_test_details.non_estimable_policy: If point estimate or any replicate is undefined, report counts/reasons and support, never replace with zero or redraw. That confirmatory test is NON_ESTIMABLE and cannot pass; use p=1 only as a conservative multiplicity placeholder, not an estimated p-value, keeping full family size. Valid-replicate percentile summaries may be descriptive only and must state their denominator.
bootstrap_test_details.point_estimate_symbol: theta_hat: paired mean difference, group interaction difference, or beta_M as applicable.
bootstrap_test_details.replicate_error: e_b = theta_star_b - theta_hat; refit the entire fixed construct model per replicate.
bootstrap_test_details.ties: Inclusive >= in tail counts; plus-one finite simulation correction.

RQ1.k_star: Smallest finite k in [1,2,4,8,16] passing NI after Holm across all five tests.

M_is_unchanged.raw_CT_ST_count: Exactly 7 * M_is; not a separate confirmatory outcome.

statistical_core.estimand_weighting: Each target turn equally weighted in the point estimate; cluster resampling handles dependence, not transcript-equal reweighting.
statistical_core.insufficient_group_information: Report non-estimable contrasts and group/transcript support; never merge/redefine groups after quality inspection.
statistical_core.mechanism_bootstrap: Compute both group-specific paired means within each shared cluster draw, then subtract. Do not independently resample groups. Empty-group replicates are undefined, must be counted/reported, and must never be assigned zero or silently redrawn.
statistical_core.paired_standardized_effect: d_z = mean(paired differences) / sample SD(paired differences); undefined if SD=0. Report raw paired difference as primary, and do not treat d_z observations as independent transcripts.
statistical_core.primary_effects: Paired within-target differences on shared target populations; no unpaired comparison of differently composed conditions.
statistical_core.resampling: Draw transcript IDs with replacement; each draw retains all eligible targets, current-paper condition vectors and fixed mechanism labels for that transcript. Duplicated clusters carry multiplicity. Use the same draw for both sides of each paired or interaction contrast.
